purpose: Oracle-free external size baseline for majority witness representation. This lineage is never imported by the blind constructor.

family.name: ODD_IMPLICIT_MAJORITY_SKOL_RELATION
family.relation_semantics: x must equal MAJ_n(Y); hostile input representation will omit an explicit x:=MAJ(Y) output node.

reference_builder.representation: canonical hash-consed binary counting decision DAG
reference_builder.state: (i,c) = after reading i boundary bits, c ones observed, with early TRUE/FALSE terminals when threshold reached or unreachable

theorem_baseline.claim: The number of reachable counting states is O(n^2); therefore a polynomial shared decision-DAG representation exists for every odd n in the family.
theorem_baseline.finite_run_role: Measure exact canonical node counts for the preregistered n-values only; finite scaling is not itself a proof of polynomial synthesis.
